schema.about: GAME DATA only: official/current hero identity. Competitive usage lives in data/meta/<dataset>-usage.json.
schema.lanes: primary lane plus flex lanes with a weight 0-1 (how natural the flex lane is; primary = 1)
schema.class: official hero class(es); a description, not a draft role
schema.functions: what the hero does in a composition
schema.archetypes: engage, pickoff, dive, poke, protect, frontToBack, scale
schema.ratings: 0-3 each. frontline, engage, cc, burst, damage (sustained), poke, mobility, peel, sustain, objective, dive (backline access), early, scaling
schema.forms: optional: distinct playable forms with rating overrides; the engine scores each form against the draft
schema.flags: antiDive, antiDash, antiPoke, antiHeal, antiCC, tankShred, lastPick
schema.profile: reviewed = confirmed by the user; baseline = first-pass estimate; provisional = estimate from incomplete source info
